content.comment_body: Hello, we received a customer request regarding transferring a program from one [product_name] with article number [article_no] to another module with article number [article_no]. The software in use is a demo version of [product_name]. I managed to retrieve the program from the first module by comparing and copying it to a new project, then attempted to transfer firmware files and the program onto a Micro SD card and insert it into the second module while powered off, but this did not work. Any advice or a step-by-step guide would be greatly appreciated. Is it possible to do this using the demo software, and do both module part numbers need to match for compatibility? I've attached the original program copy. Kind regards, [user_name]

Welcome to the forum, [user_name]. The demo version you’re using only recognizes older [product_name] hardware, specifically the first generation. The modules with part numbers ending in [article_no] are newer hardware, which corresponds to a later generation. This hardware cannot be selected in the demo version. To program this newer module, you need at least the full version of [product_name] software of [version_no] or newer. To access all features, it’s recommended to use the latest release. If you have an older full version, upgrades are available for free. Edit: If your hardware runs on firmware version [version_no], then a firmware update isn’t possible, as it's already current.

Thank you for your response. How can someone obtain a full version of the software if they’ve never owned one previously? I downloaded the demo version from a [company_name] forum and this is my first time using it.

If you don’t yet have a full version, you’ll need to purchase one. The full version DVD has article number [article_no]. You can find it online from various vendors, sometimes even on second-hand sites for older releases.

A technical question was forwarded from [user_name]: Unfortunately, the Update Center in [product_name] isn’t functioning. You can download the current Windows update package online. It’s about 1.3 GB. After downloading, install the update with Administrator privileges.
Additionally, consider starter kits which include the hardware and a free full software license, plus a project box.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered compatibility issues transferring programs between different [product_name] modules due to software version restrictions. The demo edition lacked support for newer hardware models, making at least the full version of [product_name] necessary. The discussion highlighted confusion around software acquisition, firmware compatibility, and precise steps required for program transfer, thus exposing both user knowledge gaps and product limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects a straightforward way to transfer a program between two [product_name] hardware modules using available demo software, seeking simple compatibility guidance and transfer instructions. The user hopes to avoid complex procedures and additional purchases if possible.
